ImageDescription.value: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing a classic Israeli weekday family dinner prepared and served at the Portal family home. The table includes hummus with olive oil, hard-boiled eggs, chopped Israeli salad, sliced tomatoes, carrots, onions, and green peppers, coleslaw, tahini-based spreads, fresh pita bread, and dairy-based dips. This image documents everyday home cooking and shared family meals in Israel as part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.

ImageDescription.value: High-quality photograph taken by Liat Portal showing a full Israeli shawarma meal arranged on a dark table. The dishes include shaved lamb and beef shawarma, hummus topped with harissa (harif is spicy in Hebrew) and parsley, a container of tahini, fries, pita, pickled vegetables, fresh salads, and roasted eggplant. Olive oil is visible in the hummus topping and some salads. Shot from above as part of a global documentation project of everyday food culture for Foodie Disorder.
